_comment: Repos whose per-repository GitHub Security Advisories we ingest (github_repo source). For non-ecosystem software (desktop apps, firmware, standalone binaries) whose advisories never reach the global GHSA feed. Package software does NOT belong here — it comes in via the `ghsa` source. Each entry is either "owner/repo" or {"repo": "owner/repo", "cpe": "cpe:2.3:a:vendor:product"}. The optional CPE (canonical CPE 2.3, special chars escaped) lets a scanner that reports the app by CPE actually match.
